faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I place an order?
faq.a1: Fill in the order form on this page — it opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send. You can also call 97896 51814 or walk into either branch.
faq.q2: Do you take bulk uniform orders for schools and offices?
faq.a2: Yes. We stitch school and office uniforms in all models, for individuals as well as institutions. Share the quantity and model on WhatsApp for a quote.
faq.a3: It depends on the design and how busy the season is. We confirm the delivery date with you when we take your measurements.
faq.q4: Do you buy and sell used sewing machines?
faq.a4: Yes. We sell new machines and buy and sell used ones. Send the machine model and a photo on WhatsApp.
faq.q5: Can I learn tailoring with you?
faq.a5: Yes. Sakthi Tailoring Training School teaches cutting and stitching hands-on at the shop. See the Training School page for details.
